text:
maya: Quick proposal — add a `calibrated_prob` field to the rerank response and expose a per-candidate integer `units` so quotas reflect cost. Draft sketch below, want quick sanity check before I land console changes.

alex: What's the main win here vs the current `score` we return?

maya: Two things: 1) `calibrated_prob` is a 0..1 estimate that teams can use directly in UX/thresholding without doing their own transform. 2) `units` lets us bill and quota at candidate granularity (some models and candidates cost more because of context/prefetch tokens).

jamie: I like the UX clarity. Important to note: calibration must be model-versioned and stable. Otherwise dashboards will show weird drifts. We should tie telemetry to model_version and calibration_version.

pat: Payload size concern — adding floats for every candidate could bloat heavy fanouts. Can we make `calibrated_prob` optional and sample full payloads?

maya: Yep — default: full output includes `score_raw` (logit) and `tokens`. `calibrated_prob` and `units` are included unless client sets `?lite=true` or header `X-Rerank-Sample:lite`. We'll also support server-side sampling for telemetry. Example response: 

```json
{
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "c1", "score_raw": -0.22, "calibrated_prob": 0.41, "tokens": 12, "units": 1 },
    { "id": "c2", "score_raw": 1.8, "calibrated_prob": 0.86, "tokens": 40, "units": 3 }
  ],
  "quota_units": 4,
  "model_version": "rerank-v3",
  "calibration_version": "cal-v2026-03"
}
```

sofia: For quotas: `units` should be integer and additive. Default units=1 for short candidates. Console should show expected monthly `units` per route (est based on sample). Also expose `units_p50/p95` in the model dashboard.

alex: Fallback behaviour: if a model/version doesn't have a calibration profile, `calibrated_prob` => `null` and we set `units` based on `tokens` heuristic. Clients should treat `calibrated_prob==null` as "not available" not as zero.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Canary deploy started: rerank-api v2 -> canary pool (10%)

maya: I'll open the API PR with the schema and a migration guide (backwards compatible: `score_raw` stays). I'll also add console work: per-route quota mapping, units estimates, and telemetry (sampled full payloads + p50/p95 unit cost). Planning 1% sampled full payloads + deterministic sampling key for reproducibility.

alex: :thumbsup: please add a short e2e test that simulates mixed-size candidates so we don't regress billing math.

maya: Will do — thanks everyone. I'll ping when PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/rerank-api/pulls/1234
